definitions.gloss: to observe; to watch closely; to examine carefully
definitions.explanation: To look at something attentively and systematically in order to learn about it. Used in scientific, educational, and everyday contexts for careful examination of people, nature, or phenomena.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}を{観察|かんさつ}する。
{子|こ}どもたちが{虫|むし}を{観察|かんさつ}している。
{患者|かんじゃ}の{様子|ようす}を{注意深|ちゅういぶか}く{観察|かんさつ}して、{変化|へんか}があれば{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please observe the patient carefully and report any changes.

notes:
Implies systematic, purposeful watching — not casual looking. Commonly used in science education, nature study, and medical/clinical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}を{観察|かんさつ}する: to observe nature
- {行動|こうどう}を{観察|かんさつ}する: to observe behavior
- {観察|かんさつ}{力|りょく}: powers of observation
- {観察|かんさつ}{日記|にっき}: observation diary (common school assignment)
- {経過|けいか}{観察|かんさつ}: follow-up observation (medical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見|み}る: to look, see — general and casual
- {注目|ちゅうもく}する: to pay attention to, focus on — emphasizes directing attention
- {監視|かんし}する: to monitor, surveil — implies watching for security or control purposes
- {観測|かんそく}する: to observe (scientific instruments) — used for weather, astronomy
